tasks.short: Analyze financial performance, forecast revenues and expenses, and advise management.

steps.what: Export actual results and commercial activity.
Map accounts, reconcile totals, and calculate historical trends.
Read contracts and schedules for future commitments and obligations.

loop.input: Contracts and schedules missing structured commitment fields.
loop.output: Amounts, dates, conditions and source passages for a commitment schedule.
loop.check: Validate currencies and dates; reconcile amounts to schedules; accountant checks conditional clauses.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; unresolved fields go to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured fields first. Remaining obligations depend on varied contractual wording.

steps.what: Challenge operating drivers and agree forecast assumptions with business owners.
Calculate forecasts and sensitivities using agreed assumptions.
Write findings, risks, and recommended management actions.

loop.input: Validated scenario tables, assumptions and accountant-selected recommendations.
loop.output: Draft advisory memo with linked figures and explicit uncertainties.
loop.check: Resolve every figure to a scenario cell; accountant checks reasoning and recommendations.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported explanations are flagged for manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables use templates; a short model loop connects case-specific assumptions and risks.

steps.what: Approve advice for management and assign follow-up actions.

tasks.design: Scheduled integrations load {ERP} and {CRM} data into the {DATA_PLATFORM}, where versioned rules reconcile totals and calculate scenarios for {BI}. Bounded loops extract unstructured commitments from {CLM} and draft a memo in {DOCS}; people approve assumptions and recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data mappings, contract interpretation and changing assumptions made a complete solution expensive to maintain. Existing reporting often covered historical results only.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding reduces implementation effort for connectors, reconciliation rules and scenario generators. Bounded extraction and drafting can assist the remaining document work.
tasks.still_hard: Forecasts remain sensitive to uncertain demand, conditional obligations and management behaviour. Faster calculation does not establish causation.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge optimistic assumptions, understand operating constraints and recommend actions management can actually carry out.

ambition.what: A monthly decision on whether to defer discretionary spending under a downside revenue scenario.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time assembling packs and more time testing operating assumptions. They can initiate scenario reviews; spending authority stays with management.

reach.task: Evaluate the financial case for a capacity investment.
reach.learn: Discounted cash flow, scenario probabilities and investment appraisal.

evidence.claim: Reconciliation, driver calculations and sensitivity tables can use deterministic rules; forecast assumptions require judgement.
Contract extraction and memo drafting are proposed bounded loops, not evidenced forecasting outcomes.

assumptions: This is management forecasting rather than statutory assurance.
Source systems permit approved exports or read access.
Time shares are planning estimates informed by the supplied priors; judgement remains substantial.
Build ranges estimate working effort for a scoped pilot, not elapsed procurement time.
GDPR controls apply to personal data; EU AI Act applicability depends on intended use. National consultation rules require local assessment.
unknowns: Available interfaces, account mappings and historical data quality.
Whether commitments already exist as structured records.
Who can approve assumptions and release advice.
Whether employee-level data or national consultation requirements enter scope.
research_questions: Which revenue and cost drivers improve forecast accuracy against a simple baseline?
How reliably can conditional commitments be extracted from representative contracts?
new_work: Resolve reconciliation exceptions and maintain account mappings.
Review extracted commitments and memo claims.
Version assumptions and measure forecast error.
Maintain connectors, permissions and model-loop checks.

tasks.short: Maintain budgets and explain actual costs against approved plans.

steps.what: Retrieve period actuals and check that the accounting period is ready.
Consolidate departmental budgets and align account and cost-centre mappings.
Update departmental assumptions and explain material changes.
Calculate revised budgets and check submissions against planning rules.
Approve the budget version and any changes to spending limits.
Compare actuals with approved budgets and flag material variances.
Prepare the periodic report with supported explanations and proposed corrective actions.

tasks.design: Configure budget versions, submission forms and approval routing in {ERP} and {WORKFLOW}, with deterministic consolidation for departmental inputs. Feed approved versions and period actuals into {BI}; a report generator inserts tables and supplied explanations into {DOCS}, while the accountant writes the interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departmental templates, inconsistent mappings and weak version control made consolidation fragile. Useful budget features were often only partly configured.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing configuration handles much of the workflow. AI coding makes the remaining validations, mappings and report templates cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: Budget negotiation, credible assumptions and distinguishing timing differences from lasting overspend remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge explanations, negotiate achievable plans and connect a variance to a concrete operating decision.

ambition.what: A monthly decision on reallocating uncommitted departmental spending.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time consolidating files and more time challenging material variances. They gain the ability to convene reallocation reviews; budget approval rights do not change.

reach.task: Assess competing requests for departmental funding.
reach.learn: Driver-based planning, prioritisation methods and operational capacity constraints.

evidence.claim: Budget consolidation, version checks and actual-versus-budget calculations are suitable for configuration and deterministic code.
The proposed design needs no model loop when owners provide explanations and accountants interpret them.

assumptions: The company uses departmental planning files alongside reporting in the {ERP} or {BI}.
Existing software can hold budget versions and support structured submissions.
The supplied high automation prior fits calculation work better than budget negotiation.
Build ranges estimate working effort for a scoped pilot.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are assessed for the deployed scope; national consultation requirements depend on employee data use.
unknowns: Number of budget templates, entities and currencies.
How late journals and budget revisions are handled.
Approval limits, access restrictions and consultation requirements.
research_questions: Can existing configuration replace departmental consolidation files?
Which variance thresholds produce a manageable set of actionable exceptions?
new_work: Maintain account mappings, planning drivers and report templates.
Resolve rejected submissions and late accounting changes.
Reconcile dashboard totals to the ledger.
Review access and preserve approved budget versions.

tasks.short: Represent clients in tax disputes and support financial litigation.

steps.what: Read the authority notice and record scope, deadlines, and required responses.

loop.output: Draft case fields, quoted deadlines and source passages.
loop.check: Accountant verifies scope and every deadline; legal deadline calculations use maintained national rules.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair; ambiguity prevents automatic deadline confirmation.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use portal fields where available; remaining notices contain varied unstructured requests.

steps.what: Retrieve returns, ledger entries, and supporting documents.
Prepare the financial chronology and reconcile disputed amounts.

loop.output: Cited chronology and candidate links between claims and evidence.
loop.check: Code reconciles amounts; accountant verifies dates, source links, omissions and contradictory evidence.
loop.stop: One pass and one repair per evidence batch; unresolved contradictions remain explicit.
loop.why_not_simpler: Amounts reconcile deterministically; correspondence must be read to identify relevant events.

steps.what: Agree the case position, risks, and negotiation mandate with the client.
Draft the response and supporting financial explanations.

loop.input: Approved position, selected evidence and references verified by the representative.
loop.output: Draft response with evidence citations and financial schedules.
loop.check: Tie all amounts to schedules; representative verifies arguments, citations, privilege and disclosure scope.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims are removed or written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates supply structure, but the explanation must address case-specific facts and arguments.

steps.what: Approve the factual position and release of the submission.
File the approved submission and retain proof of delivery.
Present evidence, answer challenges, and negotiate within the agreed mandate.
Authorize any binding settlement or concession requiring client approval.
Record the outcome, accounting consequences, and next deadlines.

tasks.design: A restricted case register in {WORKFLOW} links evidence from {ERP} and {DOCS}, tracks verified deadlines and generates financial schedules. Bounded loops prepare cited chronologies and draft responses; approved submissions pass through {GOV_PORTAL}, while representation and settlement decisions remain with authorized people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fragmented evidence, varied correspondence and national procedures made preparation costly. Legal judgement and representative credentials prevented end-to-end automation.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable case records, document indexing and deterministic schedules reduce preparation work. Bounded reading and drafting can help without taking over representation.
tasks.still_hard: National rules determine representation rights, privilege, deadlines and procedure. Portal automation may be unavailable; legal interpretation, negotiation and disclosure decisions remain demanding.
tasks.human_edge: Earn client trust, assess credibility, respond to challenges and judge when a concession serves the client's interests.

ambition.what: A fixed-scope tax-dispute readiness review before the first formal response.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time assembling evidence and more time evaluating the case with the representative. Preparation improves, but legal representation and settlement rights do not expand.

reach.task: Trace a disputed tax position back to return calculations and supporting records.
reach.learn: Tax workpaper conventions, national procedure and evidence requirements.

reach.task: Build an evidence chronology for a contested financial transaction.
reach.learn: Evidence provenance, interview discipline and handling contradictory records.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with income and corporate tax returns while the user remains responsible; this does not establish litigation capability.
Evidence preparation and financial schedules can be separated from human representation and settlement authority.

assumptions: This task concerns an accountant serving clients or supporting an appointed representative; many internal accountants would only support their employer.
A qualified representative supplies verified legal references and national procedural rules.
Filing configuration is feasible only through supported portal facilities; manual filing remains the fallback.
Time shares represent a case that reaches negotiation; other cases stop earlier.
Build ranges estimate pilot effort and include confidentiality, access and applicable consultation work.
GDPR applies to personal evidence. EU AI Act obligations depend on intended use; this design supports an authorized party rather than adjudicating disputes.
unknowns: Whether the accountant may represent clients under the applicable national rules.
Client approval requirements and delegated negotiation limits.
Available portal interfaces and credential restrictions.
Evidence sensitivity, privilege requirements and approved processing locations.
Whether national employee consultation is required.
research_questions: Can representative case documents produce complete chronologies with verifiable source links?
Which filing steps support configuration without automating representative credentials?
Which national deadline rules need specialist maintenance?
new_work: Verify extracted dates, evidence links and legal references.
Maintain case permissions, retention rules and deadline logic.
Check disclosure scope and document versions before filing.
Handle unsupported portal steps and retain delivery receipts.

tasks.short: Direct staff who prepare, record, file, and transmit financial records.

steps.what: Inspect record queues, missing documents, and upcoming deadlines.
Set priorities and discuss capacity or unusual cases with the team.
Assign batches and update the shared work tracker.
Check batch completeness and validate coding against source records.
Review exceptions and approve the batch for its intended use.
Chase outstanding corrections and missing supporting documents.
Transmit the approved batch to its designated external recipient.
Archive delivery evidence and update completion status.

tasks.design: Configure a shared queue in {WORKFLOW} linked to {ERP} and {DOCS}, with assignments, validation rules, reminders and receipt capture. A {BI} view exposes overdue records and unresolved exceptions; approved external transmissions use a supported {GOV_PORTAL} interface with an accountant's release gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ownership and status were split across system queues, shared files and mailboxes. External submission channels and inconsistent record formats complicated automation.
tasks.enabler_now: Workflow configuration handles routing and reminders. AI coding reduces the cost of record checks, connector code and receipt matching without requiring a model.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual accounting treatment, conflicting deadlines, staff development and unsupported external channels still need people. National rules may require consultation where the queue changes employee monitoring.
tasks.human_edge: Balance workload fairly, coach staff and decide when an exception needs correction, escalation or specialist advice.

ambition.what: A pre-submission completeness check for departmental financial record batches.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time chasing status and more time resolving exceptions and coaching staff. They can redirect routine batches within existing delegation; filing and accounting approval rights stay explicit.

reach.task: Maintain evidence that required financial submissions were complete and timely.
reach.learn: Control design, evidence retention and escalation requirements.

reach.task: Identify recurring causes of record-processing delays.
reach.learn: Process metrics, event data and privacy-preserving reporting.

evidence.claim: DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and tests of details with team review and sign-off; this supports the validation component, not staff direction.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tick-and-tie falling from eight to two hours and test-of-details savings of 40–50%; these are vendor-reported audit results.
Queue routing, reminders, validation checks and receipt matching can be deterministic.

assumptions: The sequence shows a representative externally transmitted batch; internal-only batches need a different release route.
Shares cover the supervised workflow across roles rather than only the supervisor's touch time.
Routine assignments follow agreed availability and skills rules, with manual overrides.
External automation requires a supported interface; otherwise a clerk performs submission manually.
Build ranges estimate pilot effort, including access and applicable employee consultation.

GDPR applies to personal records. National consultation requirements must be checked if employee monitoring changes; EU AI Act classification must be reassessed before adding AI-based staff allocation.
unknowns: Which records, recipients and submission channels are in scope.
Existing queue, validation and retention capabilities.
Whether source documents are structured enough for deterministic checks.
Assignment rules, segregation requirements and release authority.
Whether the proposed queue changes employee monitoring under national rules.
research_questions: Which controls can run on every record before human review?
Can delivery receipts be reliably matched to approved batch versions?
Which queue metrics improve coordination without becoming individual performance scores?
new_work: Maintain validation rules, assignment rules and recipient requirements.
Resolve failed transmissions and unmatched receipts.
Review access, retention settings and override logs.
Investigate recurring exceptions and coach staff on their causes.

role.altitude: The role shifts from assembling files and coordinating status to testing assumptions, resolving exceptions and advising decision makers. Financial approvals, representation rights and settlement authority remain tied to explicit delegation.
reach: Budget Analysts: evaluate funding trade-offs using driver-based plans.
Financial and Investment Analysts: assess investment scenarios and sensitivities.
Compliance Officers: connect financial records to submission and control evidence.
skills_to_grow: Account mapping, reconciliation controls and data lineage.
Workflow configuration and integration acceptance testing.
Verification of extracted evidence and generated prose.
National procedural requirements, GDPR and applicable EU AI Act obligations.
Business challenge, negotiation and staff coaching.
role.ambitious_version: An accountant who runs a reliable financial evidence and scenario service: management gets timely spending choices, departments get clearer control feedback, and authorized representatives get better-prepared case files.
